The checks on `sourceVisualRequirement` using `.includes()` are case-sensitive. If the source posture map contains mixed-case or uppercase strings (e.g., 'Source_Figure' or 'Visual'), these checks will fail to identify the visual requirement. Converting `sourceVisualRequirement` to lowercase first ensures robust case-insensitive matching.

```javascript
  const requirementLower = sourceVisualRequirement.toLowerCase();
  const visualRequired = requiresImageContext
    || requirementLower.includes('source_figure')
    || requirementLower.includes('visual');
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To ensure full alignment with `readQuestionContext` in `copilot-evidence-wording-gate.js`, `normalizeCopilotContextPacket` should support `questionRow` and `question_row` when extracting the posture question. Additionally, ensure the normalization function defensively handles nullish inputs by falling back to an empty object before property reads, and include regression test coverage for null or default states.

```suggestion
  const safeSource = source || {};
  const postureQuestion =
    safeSource.full_beta_question
    ?? safeSource.fullBetaQuestion
    ?? safeSource.full_beta_question_row
    ?? safeSource.fullBetaQuestionRow
    ?? safeSource.question
    ?? safeSource.questionRow
    ?? safeSource.question_row
    ?? null;
```
